description: This file defines an enum called DatatableColumnType, which categorizes different data types for datatable columns such as string, number, boolean, decimal, date, datetime, text, and dropdown. It includes a method to resolve a string to its corresponding enum value using an external EnumResolver utility.

classes.name: DatatableColumnType
classes.description: Enumeration of data types for datatable columns, with a string representation for each type.

methods.name: fromTypeString
methods.description: Converts a string representing a type into the corresponding DatatableColumnType enum value, using the EnumResolver utility.
